units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 6a:8">B. Bath. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>בקרנא ול׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בקנתא ובלָפָתָא</he>, read <he>בקרנ׳</he>) if a neighbor built against the party wall in an angle and joined his wall to it with couplings; [Ar. <he>בל׳ ובקרן זוית</he> if a neighbor joined a previously erected structure to the party wall or built against the latter in an angle].
